scope: Active Return must preserve a currently opened newer panel or embedded workspace at the asynchronous UI effect. No authority, routing or backend change.
changes: Queued own-room arrival opens the work-entry panel only if no other panel/workspace is current at effect time.
Denied-Stand/route fallback opens My work only if no other panel/workspace is current; otherwise reports that My work remains in the toolbelt.
alternativeDecision: Used current UI at effect time instead of adding a panel-interaction generation: it preserves currently open explicit Options/work, while normal Return may still offer its entry if the user has already closed a temporary tool. This is an implementation choice verified by behavioral tests, not a human comparison.
reproductions: active Return -> real onSnapshot(null) -> Options -> own-room snapshot; old arrival replaced Options
active Return -> real null -> own-room snapshot -> explicit new work/draft before queued effect; old arrival replaced it
pending Stand in active Return -> newer Options -> denied Stand; old fallback replaced it
positiveControls: ordinary legitimate Return still opens work entry
normal denied Stand still opens work draft
